_how: The Videos page (labsnmx.com/videos/). One entry per video, shown in this order. kind: youtube (id = the 11-character video id), drive (id = the Google Drive file id; the file must be shared as Anyone with the link) or file (src = /assets/video/<name>.mp4, or a full https link to an .mp4). uploaded: the date the video was first published (for Google). related: optional link to our own post. active: false hides it. Made with Content Blog Creator.html; the build writes the page.
